name: never_red_scores_vacuous
why: If ctc scored a never-red check as GREEN instead of VACUOUS, every self-graded suite downstream (converge, staircase, docket) would certify checks that have never caught anything — the green-checkmark-that-means-nothing this tool exists to abolish.

name: broken_not_red
why: If a non-executable prose/typo case (exit 126/127) counted as RED, a typo would certify a claim: a permanently-absent case wearing a failing case clothes would satisfy the falsifiability rule while having tested nothing.

name: weakened_loses_red_history
why: If a case weakened until it passes inherited the red history of the strict case it replaced, an agent could rewrite any failing test into true and ship green — the single most common way a proof gate dies, silently.

name: honest_red_then_green
why: If a case seen RED then GREEN after the work were NOT reported GREEN, the red-before-green contract would be broken and no honest case could ever certify — the tool would reject the very workflow it prescribes.
